scope: 28-day four-act event expansion; outdoor Springfield only; original objects and save must be retained

chapters.prologue: Retain existing six Springfield After Dark quests as optional introduction, not required for crossover progression

acts.title: The Mystery Machine Arrives
acts.setting: Evergreen Terrace and the temporary Mystery Inc. camp
acts.summary: A mysterious green van rolls into Springfield while flickering pumpkins and runaway ghosts frighten Homer. The gang sets up a temporary investigation base.
quests: Inspect Halloween decorations; place one glowing pumpkin
Collect 5 wandering ghosts; send Homer on a 1-hour candy search
Collect 3 clue drops; have Lisa research footprints
Complete Bart's prank job; place 3 cobweb fences
Investigate two nearby houses; earn 250 total candy

acts.title: The Schoolhouse Ghoul
acts.setting: Springfield Elementary and its outdoor playground
acts.summary: A bell rings from the empty school and a masked ghoul appears. A smaller prank is exposed, but the real Phantom slips away.
quests: Examine the school bell; collect 4 clue drops
Place a trap net; complete a trap-preparation job
Complete two school investigations; place a fog machine
Complete the playground chase; find 5 clue drops

acts.title: The Reactor Riddle
acts.setting: Nuclear Power Plant, cooling towers and surrounding streets
acts.summary: The gang traces strange footprints, glowing slime and mechanical noises to the Power Plant. Lisa finds evidence of remote-controlled ghosts.
quests: Investigate the Power Plant exterior; find 4 clues
Complete Lisa's research job; inspect 2 slime puddles
Catch 10 roaming ghosts; finish a Scooby chase job
Place 2 glowing barrels; set 2 outdoor traps
Collect 8 clues; investigate a ghost drone
Phantom Signal Antenna decoration and 200 candy

acts.title: The Phantom of Springfield
acts.setting: Abandoned Krustylu backlot and the Phantom's stage
acts.summary: The gang traps a masked figure after tracing the mechanical ghosts to a deserted film set. Mr. Burns is exposed as the mastermind of a scare scheme.
quests: Build the outdoor Phantom Backlot; inspect 3 props
Five Scooby Snacks and a Plan
Collect 5 snack drops; craft 3 trap parts
Place 3 traps; complete a 4-hour decoy job
And I Would Have Gotten Away With It...
Read final unmask dialogue; place the commemorative Mystery Plaque
Mystery Inc. Detective Office and event completion

narrative.title: Springfield After Dark: The Mystery Inc. Files
narrative.premise: An unexplained haunting draws Mystery Inc. to Springfield. A string of fake ghosts conceals Mr. Burns' scheme to frighten the neighbourhood away from a newly valuable site. A mysterious floating donut remains unexplained after the unmasking.
antagonists: Milhouse in a ghost costume (Act 2 red herring)
Mr. Burns as the Phantom (Act 4 reveal)
narrative.style: family-friendly mystery and light Simpsons comedy

progression.actFlow: sequential quest unlocks, not locked to real calendar weeks
progression.currencyRule: cumulative earned; milestone prizes never deduct currency
progression.mysteryClues: quest progress items, not paid currency
progression.tappable: ghosts and clue drops, spawn rate limited
progression.saveMigration: Namespace v0.2 under event ID; do not overwrite v0.1 or core game save

reusedVisualRules: Clone permitted source asset into a separate event item ID
Preserve source sprite atlases and native object data intact
Retain collision footprint only after comparing to native grid
Adapt animation timing/effect emitters only after native loader format is known
Human walk timing may be reused; new Scooby quadruped frames need separate artwork
Check effect anchor points such as chimney smoke and vehicle exhaust in-game
Do not assume APK PNGs load directly; inspect atlas/resource bundle requirements
openQuestions: Current game cache/master files unavailable in provided APK and assets.zip
Existing character walking sprite format, animation timelines and effects have not been verified
Native event identifiers and reward/save hooks unknown
Official rights for redistribution of licensed crossover content require confirmation prior to public release
QA: Proof of concept: add one new stand-alone building, retaining its original source building
Smoke must originate from the correct roof/chimney in every applicable frame
Inspect sprite pivot/alignment, footprint and tap hit area
Verify character walk/idle loops do not jump between frames
Restart BlueStacks and confirm reward unlock and item placement survive
Verify save migration, timers, clock changes, event expiry and storage limits
Verify signing certificate matches installed Homer app before offering an in-place update
deliverable: Planning data only: no modified native game binaries, character sprites or playable APK
